fact: The Garden of Welcome is a plateau rising high above the rest of the grove, screened by towering zurkhwood stalks.
source_quote: The Garden of Welcome was a nightmare made real. The plateau rose high above the rest of the grove, screened by towering zurkhwood stalks
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: The party enters the Garden of Welcome through Rumpadump's secret route.
source_quote: The party enters through Rumpadump's secret route
subject: party enters Garden

fact: The garden is illuminated only by a few glowing mushrooms along the edge.
source_quote: Only a few glowing mushrooms along the edge provide light.
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: Heads of creatures from a dozen different Underdark races peek from the soil with bodies consumed by mold.
source_quote: the heads of creatures from a dozen different Underdark races peeked from the soil, their bodies consumed by mold
subject: consumed heads

fact: Xinaya is a drow woman whose face is half-rotted and blooming with tiny fungi.
source_quote: a drow woman named Xinaya, her face half-rotted and blooming with tiny fungi
subject: Xinaya

fact: Xinaya raises a spider medallion embedded in the fungal mass that had once been her hand.
source_quote: who raised a spider medallion embedded in the fungal mass that had once been her hand
subject: Xinaya

fact: Xinaya begs the party to end her suffering.
source_quote: She begged the party in desperate, broken words to end her suffering
subject: Xinaya

fact: Xinaya warns the party that Zuggtmoy is present.
source_quote: warned that Zuggtmoy, the Lady of Decay, was present.
subject: Xinaya

fact: Xinaya laughs hysterically at the reversal of fortune because she must beg the party for salvation.
source_quote: Xinaya recognized the party and laughed hysterically at the reversal of fortune: she had been sent by Ilvara to search for and capture them near the grove, only to find herself begging those same fugitives for salvation.
subject: Xinaya

fact: Xinaya was part of a patrol sent by Ilvara to search near the grove and capture the party.
source_quote: She reveals she was part of a patrol sent by Ilvara to search near the grove and capture the party.
subject: Xinaya

fact: Ilvara had reserved the privilege of killing the fugitives for herself.
source_quote: Ilvara had reserved the privilege of killing the fugitives for herself.
subject: Ilvara

fact: Xinaya and her patrol accepted Phylo's invitation to visit the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: She and her patrol had made the fatal mistake of accepting Phylo's invitation to visit the Garden of Welcome.
subject: patrol trap

fact: Xinaya recognizes Daz as being from Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: She urged Daz, whom she recognized as being from Menzoberranzan
subject: Xinaya

fact: Xinaya urges Daz to warn the other Drow that the Demon Queen of Fungi had entered the Underdark.
source_quote: warn the other Drow that the Demon Queen of Fungi had entered the Underdark.
subject: Xinaya

fact: Yestabrod is a disgusting larval creature with vestigial fungal growths suggesting it was once a myconid.
source_quote: a disgusting larval creature named Yestabrod rises from the ground, its vestigial fungal growths suggesting that it might once have been a myconid.
subject: Yestabrod

fact: Yestabrod speaks both aloud and in the party's minds.
source_quote: Yestabrod speaks both aloud and in the party's minds, gurgling and spitting as it welcomes them.
subject: Yestabrod

fact: Yestabrod welcomes the party to a wedding rehearsal.
source_quote: It welcomed the party to a wedding rehearsal in a gurgling voice
subject: Yestabrod

fact: Yestabrod promises the party will be embraced by the 'great cedar' and made one with the 'great body'.
source_quote: Yestabrod promises that the “great cedar” will embrace them and make them one with her chosen, the “great body.”
subject: Yestabrod

fact: Two adult myconids emerge to join Yestabrod.
source_quote: Two adult myconids and drow spore servants from Xinaya's former patrol emerged to join it.
subject: myconid adults

fact: Drow spore servants from Xinaya's former patrol emerge to join Yestabrod.
source_quote: drow spore servants from Xinaya's former patrol emerged to join it.
subject: drow spore servants

fact: Yestabrod rejects the party's attempt to invoke an audit, stating there will be no audit.
source_quote: Yestabrod rejected the ploy: there would be no audit
subject: audit rejection

fact: Yestabrod summons the spore servants and myconids to attack the party.
source_quote: Yestabrod summons drow spore servants from Xinaya's former patrol and myconid adults to attack the party.
subject: attack initiation
